## W15 Measurement protocol

W15   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: the business owner has written the thresholds before the pilot; the unit of work and case mix are defined; the defect severity scale or the Client's replacement is recorded; and costs are separated.

Source basis: [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen) · [AI GRC Copilot](https://github.com/rolldabones/AI-GRC-Copilot)

**Hypothesis and pre-agreed success thresholds**

Business owner writes measurable quality, time, effort and control conditions before the pilot.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Comparable baseline and pilot cases**

Define unit of work, population, case mix, periods, operators, sample size and assignment. Balance difficulty and avoid learning the same answer twice.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Definitions to settle before measurement**

Active effort is total human minutes across all participants, including preparation, prompting, review, correction, re-review, approval and fallback. Elapsed turnaround includes waiting and queues. It ends at the recorded human release decision under Gate 7 (W13), not at the first draft. Record them separately; parallel reviewers add human effort without necessarily adding elapsed time.

First-pass acceptance measures quality before substantive correction. Final acceptance measures the released version after correction. Record material defects, omissions, unsupported claims, refusals and control failures, including failed or abandoned attempts.

**Scoring and observation method**

Define a material defect (S1 or S2 on the defect severity scale unless the Client records its own), evaluator, blinding where feasible, data capture, missing-data treatment and permitted exclusions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Separate implementation and recurring costs**

One-time: setup, training and initial control design. Recurring: monitoring, review meetings, maintenance and tool fees. Record baseline and pilot amounts; avoid double counting case time.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Report measured values, estimates and assumptions separately. Use W16 for raw observations and W17 for interpretation. Do not retrofit thresholds to results.
